column2: a small one-room peasant cottage: low rough stone and cream plaster walls with dark oak timbers, one plank door and one small shuttered window, a thick steep golden thatch roof with a rounded ridge and visible straw texture, a squat stone chimney; about 5 m long, one storey

a village cottage: dark oak timber frame with cream plaster panels on a low stone footing, a plank door, two warm-lit leaded windows with a flower box, a thick golden thatch roof with one eyebrow dormer and visible straw texture, a stone chimney; about 7 m long, one and a half storeys

a cottage: ground floor of chunky warm grey stone, upper storey of dark oak timber frame and cream plaster, a steep roof of chunky red clay tiles with one dormer window, warm-lit leaded windows with shutters, a flower box, a stone chimney; about 7 m long, two storeys

a long low farmhouse: dark oak timber frame and cream plaster on a stone footing, two plank doors and three small windows along its long side, a long thick golden thatch roof with visible straw texture and two stone chimneys; about 14 m long, one storey

a tall narrow town house: stone ground floor with a plank door, two jettied upper storeys of dark oak timber frame and cream plaster overhanging the street, warm-lit leaded windows with flower boxes, a steep roof of chunky red clay tiles with one dormer, a stone chimney; about 5 m wide, three storeys

a craftsman's workshop: an open-fronted ground floor under a heavy oak beam with a workbench, tool racks and barrels inside, stone side walls, a timber-frame and cream plaster upper storey, a steep roof of chunky red clay tiles, and a lean-to of red clay tiles on one side over stacked timber; about 8 m long, two storeys
